title.text: The Little Firefly Who Was Afraid of the Dark

s1.text: In a garden full of flowers, under a clover leaf, lives a tiny little firefly. Her name is Lila. She has see-through wings and a little pink bow on her head. Lila loves the sun, warm petals and the sweet smell of honeysuckle. But there is one thing Lila does not like at all: the dark.

s2.text: Every evening, when the sun goes down, all the fireflies fly off to dance in the night. But Lila stays hidden under her leaf. “The dark is too big, and I am too small,” she whispers. Her friends call to her: “Come on, Lila!” But Lila closes her eyes and does not move.

s3.text: One evening, Lila hears a tiny little voice. “Where is my home? I can’t see anything…” It is Tic, a baby snail, lost in the tall grass. He looks so worried. Lila feels her heart beating very fast. She is afraid of the dark, yes. But she wants to help Tic even more.

s4.text: Lila comes out from under her leaf, very slowly. The dark is there, all around her. She breathes once, twice, three times. And suddenly, something magical happens: her tummy starts to glow! A little golden light, warm and soft, lights up the grass all around. “Oh! I’m the one who is shining!”

s5.text: With her light, Lila guides Tic between the blades of grass, all the way to his home under the big stone. Mummy snail says thank you with a big smile. Then the other fireflies come and dance around Lila. The garden twinkles like a sky full of stars. Lila is not afraid anymore. She carries her light inside her.

s6.text: Later, Lila goes back under her clover leaf. Her light grows softer and softer, like a night-light. The dark does not feel so big anymore: it is just the night, rocking the garden to sleep. Lila yawns, Tic yawns, and the moon yawns too. You also have a little light in your heart. Gently close your eyes.

outro.text: Deep inside you, there is a light stronger than your fear. Good night, little one. Sweet dreams.
